subject: general
question: Find the odd one out with respect to animals’ response to abiotic factors.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Reproduce**__.

__
 
• The factor to which the animal's response is reproduce is a biotic factor.
 
• So, the correct option is** Reproduce.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• There are two types of factors affecting the ecosystem:
 
 
• **Biotic factors **
 
• **Abiotic factors**
 
 
 
• **Biotic factors** are the living parts of an ecosystem that shapes its environment.
 
• Some common biotic factors are** consumers, producers, herbivores, carnivores, omnivores, and decomposers.**
 
• **Abiotic factors **are non-living parts of an ecosystem that shapes its environment. 
 
• Five common abiotic factors are** atmosphere, temperature/ sunlight, water, chemical elements, and wind.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__ **

 
• An ecosystem is a place where the living and nonliving components 'interact with each other.
 
• **Type of ecosystems**:
 
 
• **Aquatic Ecosystem: Freshwater ecosystem, Marine ecosystem**
 
• **Terrestrial Ecosystem: Forest ecosystem, Grassland ecosystem, Tundra ecosystem, and Desert ecosystem.**
 
 
 
• The largest ecosystem in the world is the aquatic ecosystem. It constitutes 70% of the surface of the earth.
